summary: LTP and Quote clients on one NSE equity: the Quote client moves the subscription up (a PUT of the LTP code, a POST of 1501), and a 1105 text event (t:1_2885,110:...,119:...) arrives. It is an LTP (1512) message for RMoney, as its web client marks it and its adapter publishes it on the LTP topic alone: the LTP client gets it, its counts as doubles (float()), the Quote client nothing.

notes: 1105 carries the touchline codes 110-119 (families/xts/binary.rs parse_1105); it has no MessageCode and no trade time, so the frames carry no ltt.
The RMoney web client marks it 1512, so its adapter publishes an LTP frame only, as the desktop does (XtsHooks::text_1105_as_ltp), its ltq a double (float(), XtsHooks::text_1105_doubles).

The desktop holds one subscription per instrument at the highest mode its clients ask for (websocket::manager), so the Quote client changes the LTP subscription into a Quote one; the web adapter subscribes each mode on its own.

deviations.reason: The event carries no trade time; the web sends ltt 0 (.get('LastTradedTime', 0)), the desktop leaves ltt out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out; never a receipt time passed off as a trade time).
